ordering_notes.feature_id: ordered_0..ordered_3 are solver ordering labels, not physical hole IDs. They must not be documented as top-left/top-right/etc unless an independent asymmetric feature or marker ID proves that mapping.
ordering_notes.sort_centers: sort_centers() centers the four points, estimates a board plane with SVD, takes the first two in-plane singular vectors as local axes, flips one axis using the target centroid/view direction, sorts by bearing, then rotates the cycle so a long rectangle edge starts the sequence.
ordering_notes.axis_sign: PCA/SVD axes have sign ambiguity. The current rule reduces it with a view-direction check, but a symmetric rectangle still has half-turn and mirror-equivalent assignments that 4-point RMSE cannot distinguish.
